I worked with Codistan for a month to manage my social media pages, but the experience was far from what was promised. From the start, the consultant who onboarded me hyped up the company, claiming they had a team of 400 people. But if that’s true, I have no idea what they’re all doing because the work I received was extremely slow, and I had to constantly chase them just to get basic tasks done.

The proposal outlined a structured, professional approach, but what was actually delivered felt unorganized and nowhere near the quality I expected. Instead of streamlining my social media, I ended up babysitting the team, reminding them of what needed to be done. If you’re looking for an agency that takes initiative and delivers efficiently, this is not the one.
